edits.text: Two explicit tests to apply at each marker and use to bias cohesion and contra: 1) Incomplete-predicate/list test: Ask whether either side would be an unfinished predicate, a clause missing its required complement, a subordinating complement left dangling, or an incomplete item in a coordinated/list structure. If so, treat cohesion as very low and/or raise contra. 2) Bound-span test: Ask whether the cut falls inside a tightly bonded semantic span — for example a verb plus its required object or complement, a contiguous prepositional/temporal chain, or a coordinated ordinal/list phrase whose meaning depends on later elements. If the cut splits such a bound span, sharply reduce cohesion. These tests focus on whether meaning or argument structure is left syntactically or semantically incomplete, not on surface token length.

Exception for short modifiers and name parts: Single-word premodifiers, honorifics, titles, or name components should not be automatically treated as 'detached heads' if they function as self-contained labels or modifiers that can be translated independently and then reattached without changing scope or core argument structure. When a fragment is a clearly translatable label or name part that leaves the main predicate and its complements intact, use the measured cohesion value rather than imposing a blanket penalty.

Two explicit tests to apply at each marker and use to bias cohesion and contra: 1) Incomplete/list test: Would either side be an unfinished predicate, a clause missing a required complement, or an incomplete item in a coordinated/list structure? If yes, treat cohesion as very low and/or raise contra. 2) Bound-span test: Does the cut split a tightly bonded semantic span — for example a verb with its required object/complement, a contiguous prepositional/temporal chain, or a coordinated ordinal/list phrase whose meaning depends on later elements? If yes, sharply reduce cohesion. Exception for short modifiers and name parts: single-word premodifiers, honorifics, titles, or name components that act as self-contained labels and do not leave core argument structure unresolved should not be automatically penalized; use their measured cohesion value.
